name: Website Change Monitor: visual diff alerts with screenshots (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Website Change Monitor (visual diff alerts)

### How it works
Every 12 hours (or on a manual test run) the workflow starts the Apify Actor `pegton/website-screenshot-monitor` for the URLs in **Settings**. The Actor takes a full-page screenshot with cookie banners hidden (CSS only, nothing is clicked) and compares it with the previous capture of the same URL and device. Content that only moved, for example everything below a newly inserted banner, is matched to its new position, so only real changes count. Pages that changed by at least `changeThresholdPct` come back with a diff image (changes in red). **Build alert** also learns each page's usual noise and skips changes that are normal for that page. You get one e-mail (or Slack message) listing the changed pages. Unchanged pages are not returned and not charged.

### Setup
1. Apify account (the free plan includes $5 credit per month). Copy your API token: Console → Settings → API & Integrations.
2. Create a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Select it in **Start Apify run**, **Wait for run** and **Get results**.
3. In **Settings**, enter your URLs, devices and e-mail addresses.
4. Add an SMTP credential in **Send email alert**, or enable the Slack node.
5. Click **Test workflow**. The first run saves the reference screenshots. Then activate.

### Customization
Watch one block only with `elementSelector` (e.g. `#pricing`), blank widgets with `hideSelectors`, or change the schedule. Cost: about $0.002 per changed page. `maxChargeUsd` caps each run.

### Limitations
Pages behind a login or bot protection are captured as a normal visitor sees them.

## Trigger and settings
Runs every 12 hours. All values you need to change are in **Settings**.

## Capture and compare on Apify
Starts the screenshot run, waits until it has finished, then continues.

## Build and send the alert
Keeps only real changes and sends one message with the diff images.
